angle: how to explain a career switch honestly in an interview
text:
BBA karke data role ke liye interview dena tough hai kya?

Career switch wale freshers aksar darte hain jab interviewers unse poochte hain ki finance ya business background se data analytics mein kyun aaye. Sach bolo toh yeh koi weakness nahi hai, yeh aapka sabse bada advantage hai kyunki tools se zyada business thinking matter karti hai. 

Jab koi aapse puche, toh defensive mat hoiye. Ek simple formula use karo jo maine bhi apne finance aur reporting days mein dekha hai. 1) Pehle batao ki aapne apne purane role mein data gaps kahan dekhe. 2) Phir batao ki aapne Google Sheets aur SQL khud seekh kar un problems ko kaise solve kiya. 3) Finally, explain karo ki ab aap full-time ek Data Analyst kyun banna chahte ho. Jab aap business problem solve karne ki baat karte ho, toh degree ya background secondary ho jata hai.

Aapne apne career switch mein sabse mushkil sawaal ka kaise jawab diya hai?
